A part of the Create Mod

Create is a Minecraft mod focused on automation, mechanical systems, and creative engineering. Instead of relying on traditional tech-mod energy systems, Create introduces a fully kinetic power framework where rotation, stress, and motion drive every machine. This approach encourages players to design visually intuitive, physically simulated contraptions that feel integrated into the Minecraft world.

Create offers a wide range of mechanical components—such as shafts, gears, belts, flywheels, and clutches—that can be combined to form complex automated systems. Players can build farms, factories, transport networks, decorative machinery, and large-scale engineering projects with a high degree of customization and aesthetic detail.

The Emerald Totem Item is necessary to progress the Main Progression Questline by summoning Arion, Tyrant of the Emerald Wrath. As of v6.2 of LingGango, the Emerald Totem must be crafted using a Create Mod process. Crafting the item requires the same items as the previous version but must be performed inside an unheated basin compacted by a press. The simplest way to do this uses a single press, hand crank, and basin. The total necessary ingredients for the smallest version of the mechanism is 6 andesite alloy, 1 wood log, 1 iron block, and 4 planks.

1x Basin Place the basin on the ground, place the mechanical press on top, then find either side with a small grey square and place the mechanical crank to provide rotation. You can then right click the ingredients into the basin, and hold right click on the crank to power the press.
In your quest book, under the Tech section.
